Recording dir = mkdtemp(TMPDIR/checks-recording-*) outside the browser scratch/profile; removed after the callback in every settle path. One recording per session; settled after closeResources (context closed => webm final), not awaited by stop(); runtime.recordingSettled exposes it. behaviour.AC-2: Origin: takeRunOrigin(originSource, calibration) inside ready(), called by launchGuidedBrowser right after launchPersistentContext resolved and the single page exists, before verifyBrowserPreferences; taken once. startMs: before the browser effect (after journal consume + matches). endMs: when the effect result is known, before the outcome callback; null for UNKNOWN_OUTCOME (forced even if already stamped). Runner sends kind=action only; Math.round once at serialization; R2 sort; runner-side scale guard (0..maxSessionSeconds*1000, end>=start) drops the timings list (not the video) if violated. observationsAndRisks: R-1 (for @architect / OBS-008 / OBS-009): per AR-1 R4 the origin and the recording start before verifyBrowserPreferences, so the first ~0.6 s of every guided video shows chrome://version and chrome://prefs-internals (profile path, effective prefs JSON). Replay avoids this by deleting its startup-page video and opening a fresh app page; the guided launch keeps one page. No secret is on those pages (fresh profile), but it is visible content. Not changed here (would restructure launchGuidedBrowser, SC-3).
R-2: evidence dirs (TMPDIR/checks-recording-*) are removed in every settle path, but a SIGKILLed worker leaves them behind; there is no startup sweep (guidedMain is R14's).

R-3: after the R14 hunk the guided worker reads STUDIO_RUNNER_* evidence keys fail-closed; any unenumerated STUDIO_RUNNER_* variable in the guided worker env refuses startup (same rule as the replay runner). Backend ITs that spawn dist/run/guidedMain.js must set STUDIO_RUNNER_OBJECT_STORE_DIR to the root the backend reads for GuidedSessionVideoIT (the OBJECT_STORE_DIR fallback in server/config.ts KEY_SPECS).

R-4: the guided wire maps a recorder-side FAILED (recording.ts vocabulary) to UNAVAILABLE and keeps FAILED for store faults, per AR-1 negativeTestExpectations.runner_R13_R14. Replay's FINAL vocabulary is unchanged.

R-5: launchGuidedBrowser grew beyond the recordVideo line (readiness hook, BrowserHandle, host set, control-aware navigateBlank). Startup bound, process group and disposeScratch ordering are untouched (SC-3 not triggered), but OBS-009 P3 will rebase over these lines.
autoDecisions: [AUTO-DECISION] Timing scale violation -> drop the whole timings list, keep the STORED video (reason: the backend 422s the whole callback otherwise and the honest video would be lost; a subset filter would hide a clock defect).
[AUTO-DECISION] Manifest is written whenever keys exist, including UNAVAILABLE/FAILED (reason: replay writes its manifest regardless of evidence state; it is the audit record).

[AUTO-DECISION] csiId reaches the runtime as a runtime option from the claimed grant (ownership.ts), not via runner-context (reason: AR-1 autoDecision 'no runner-context field'; the grant scope is hash-bound to scopeHash).
[AUTO-DECISION] Manifest redactor is createRedactor([]) (reason: stop() wipes secrets before settle and must keep doing so; the manifest holds IDs/keys/integers/constant only, asserted canary-free).
[AUTO-DECISION] Partial launch failure (no browser handle) settles UNAVAILABLE without inspecting a startup file (reason: no recorded page reached readiness for the app; nothing playable to claim).
